ResearchProjectDef.label: managing spot
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allows setting up a basic management area on the ground to do managerial tasks. Not very efficient, but better than nothing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: simple managing desk
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allows building a simple managing desk for a more efficient management experience than the managing spot offers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: basic managing software
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop basic software for colony management.\n\nAllows building manager desks with a computer, pre-installed with a host of guaranteed bug free(tm) managing software.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced managing software
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop advanced software for colony management.\n\nAdvancements in AI and colony-aware computers allow the building of Colony Aware Supercomputers, preinstalled with ColonyManagementOS. Some colonists have reported doors opening and closing, airconditioning systems going haywire, and electric smelters suddenly turning on. Nevertheless, the manufacturer guarantees(tm) that ColonyManagementOS is not programmed to kill colonists.

ResearchProjectDef.label: power management
ResearchProjectDef.description: Create management software to monitor the colony's power usage.
